data.purpose: Reduce stock on prescription insert; restore on delete; reject if insufficient
data.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_reduce_stock__insert BEFORE INSERT ON prescription BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Insufficient stock for ' || m.medicine_name || ': available ' || m.stock_quantity || ', requested ' || NEW.quantity) FROM medicine m WHERE m.medicine_id = NEW.medicine_id AND m.stock_quantity < NEW.quantity; UPDATE medicine SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - NEW.quantity WHERE medicine_id = NEW.medicine_id; END;

data.purpose: Audit visit INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE to audit_log with changed_by from app_session
data.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit_visit__insert AFTER INSERT ON visit BEGIN INSERT INTO audit_log (table_name, action_type, record_id, changed_by, description) VALUES ('VISIT', 'INSERT', NEW.visit_id, (SELECT username FROM app_session WHERE id=1), 'New ' || NEW.visit_type || ' visit for patient ' || NEW.patient_id); END;

data.purpose: Audit bill INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE to audit_log with changed_by from app_session
data.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit_bill__insert AFTER INSERT ON bill BEGIN INSERT INTO audit_log (table_name, action_type, record_id, changed_by, description) VALUES ('BILL', 'INSERT', NEW.bill_id, (SELECT username FROM app_session WHERE id=1), 'Bill generated: total ' || NEW.total_amount || ' (' || NEW.payment_status || ')'); END;

data.purpose: Audit patient INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE to audit_log with changed_by from app_session
data.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_audit_patient__insert AFTER INSERT ON patient BEGIN INSERT INTO audit_log (table_name, action_type, record_id, changed_by, description) VALUES ('PATIENT', 'INSERT', NEW.patient_id, (SELECT username FROM app_session WHERE id=1), 'New patient registered'); END;

data.purpose: Set doctor Busy when visit becomes Under Treatment; Available when it leaves Under Treatment
data.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_doctor_status__update AFTER UPDATE OF visit_status ON visit BEGIN IF NEW.visit_status = 'Under Treatment' THEN UPDATE doctor SET availability_status = 'Busy' WHERE doctor_id = NEW.doctor_id; ELSIF OLD.visit_status = 'Under Treatment' THEN UPDATE doctor SET availability_status = 'Available' WHERE doctor_id = NEW.doctor_id; END IF; END;

data.purpose: Prevent modification or deletion of audit_log entries
data.sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_audit__update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit_log BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'AUDIT_LOG entries cannot be modified or deleted'); END;
